device.description: 16-bit low-power single-channel voltage-output DAC with 24-bit SPI-compatible write-only interface (SC70)
device.note: dac8311.pdf (SBAS439C) p.3 pin functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.7-8 timing requirements (Figures 1-2), p.23 power-on reset to zero scale, p.24 power-down modes (Table 3), p.25-26 input shift register (Figure 79) and SYNC interrupt (Figure 80)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; power-on reset fills it with zeros (p.23)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: PD1/PD0 of the last valid frame (Table 3: 00 normal, 01 1 kOhm, 10 100 kOhm, 11 Hi-Z)

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: DB23-DB22 PD1/PD0 (Table 3), DB21-DB6 data MSB first, DB5-DB0 don't care (Figure 79); executed on the 18th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high before it aborts the frame (Figure 80)

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.7-8 (timing, Figures 1-2), p.23 (power-on reset), p.24 (power-down, Table 3), p.25-26 (serial interface, input shift registers, SYNC interrupt)
notModeled: analog output, resistor string and output amplifier (VOUT is never driven); AVDD/VREF is both supply and reference
power-down output loads (1 kOhm / 100 kOhm / Hi-Z): PD1/PD0 stored in CTRL.PD only; the DAC register keeps its contents in power-down as the datasheet says
50 us power-down exit time and output settling
SCLK frequency (20 MHz below AVDD 3.6 V, 50 MHz above) and setup/hold limits t1-t10
SPI mode: data are taken on SCLK falling edges with SCLK high at SYNC fall (Figures 1-2); modeled as mode 2
the frame executes on the 18th falling edge; the last six don't-care bits are ignored (the fixed frame stops after the command)
variants: DAC8311 (14-bit, 16-bit frame) and DAC8411 (16-bit, 24-bit frame with 6 don't-care LSBs) share dac8311.pdf and the SC70-6 pinout; pin-compatible with DAC7311/DAC6311/DAC5311 (dac5311.pdf, own spec files).
